headline: Common Pitfalls in Kitchen Cabinet Upgrades
articleBody:
Upgrading your kitchen cabinets is a fantastic way to refresh your home, but there are a few common mistakes folks make that can lead to frustration. One of the biggest pitfalls is not thoroughly confirming what's included in your bid. Sometimes, things like decorative trim, side panels, or even specific hardware aren't explicitly listed, leading to unexpected costs later on. Always get a detailed breakdown of everything! Another frequent error is overlooking hidden extras – things like installation costs, delivery fees, or even charges for specialized storage accessories. Make sure you understand the full scope of the project and all potential expenses upfront.

People also often choose cabinets based solely on their appearance without digging into the quality of the materials and the warranty. A beautiful finish won't last if the underlying construction isn't solid. Always ask about the cabinet box construction, drawer quality, and hardware. A huge mistake for custom work is not field-verifying measurements before fabrication. Even a tiny discrepancy can cause big headaches later, resulting in cabinets that don't fit perfectly. Lastly, failing to review detailed shop drawings or design specifics before ordering can lead to disappointment. Make sure everything aligns with your vision on paper first.
